rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban in curriculum/training surface.
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match — voice contract.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique; author-we ban; training creator ban.
Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.

Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy, NOT student-facing curriculum.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Machine-cadence fat — empty negation, deictic drumroll, bold-label echo, citation duplication.
Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 65: 'Optional. They sit in the gap before it.' — numeral removed from prior violation; count no longer adjacent to list. Four pre-read items follow but no numeric count stated in lede.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing.
A claim binds to every body that states it.
A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Authoring/judging process rule, not applicable to file evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
